cohort: The study evaluated 57,507 delivery hospitalizations of pregnant patients who delivered at seven hospitals within a large academic health system in New York between January 1, 2018, and March 1, 2020.
finding: Black race, public health insurance, chronic hypertension, BMI >25 kg/m2, gestational weight gain >40 lb, and administration of blood products were significantly associated with an increased likelihood of postpartum readmission.
